semgrep_exceptions.reason: Network-device HTTPS discovery intentionally supports self-signed management endpoints; no credentials are sent and the target is an IPvAnyAddress-derived management IP.
Discovery URL is constructed from a validated IP address plus a fixed http/https scheme and root path, not an arbitrary user URL.
Semgrep flags mode 0700, but 0700 is intentionally restrictive owner-only access for restore working material.
Restore health URL is trusted operator configuration for the internal backend health endpoint, not request-controlled input.

misconfiguration_exceptions.reason: Development/CI image only; B3 production backend uses Dockerfile.prod and runtime non-root UID 10001.
Development image only; B3 production frontend uses nginx-unprivileged.
Static analyzer cannot infer the base image USER; Dockerfile now explicitly ends with USER 101 and B3 runtime validation proved non-root.

postgres.reason: Accepted upstream exception confined to gosu embedded in the pinned official PostgreSQL image. Any new ID fails until reviewed.
